patterns.description: 78% of cuts land on the beat (within 70 ms), so the edit is cut to the music.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.65 -> 2.40 cuts per second (3.7x faster).
Rotate effects hit on the beat (2 of 3).
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 4 times (source groups A, E).
